On this page

## Introduction[​](#introduction "Direct link to Introduction")

This is the main configuration window for Live Helper Chat. The visibility of each item within this window can be restricted to specific operators based on their permissions. The settings page can be accessed from the top menu ![](data:image/png;base64,).

Users can also access the settings page from the left menu.

![System configuration](data:image/png;base64,)

Main Configuration Window

![System configuration](/assets/images/system-configuration-71552fe6ca4bda66513cc1c76af3be8e.png)

## Permissions[​](#permissions "Direct link to Permissions")

For an operator to view the `System configuration` item, they must have the following permission:

> 'system','configuration'
